question: 1. In simple harmonic motion, does the time period depend on the initial conditions like initial displacement or velocity?

answers.a: Yes, it depends on initial conditions
answers.b: No, it does not depend on initial conditions

question: 2. In a mass-spring system undergoing simple harmonic motion, does the time period depend on the mass attached to the spring?

answers.a: Yes, it depends on the mass
answers.b: No, it does not depend on the mass

question: 3. In a simple pendulum, does the time period depend on the length of the string?

answers.a: Yes, it depends on the length
answers.b: No, it does not depend on the length
